description: This file defines a Spring component class that initializes financial activity mappings in the system. It uses an API client to create a mapping between a financial activity (asset transfer) and a GL account, intended for setup or testing purposes within the project.

classes.name: FinancialActivityMappingGlobalInitializerStep
classes.description: A Spring component responsible for initializing financial activity to GL account mappings during global setup.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Creates a mapping between a financial activity and a GL account by calling the external API.
